name: Retell
summary: Retells an article (a link, a PDF, a Word or PowerPoint file, or pasted text) so it can be listened to, and lets you practise speaking English on it: quizzes, spoken answers and live talks with a coach.

agent.summary: Articles the user listened to as retellings, and their English practice on them: read the library, an article's retelling and memo, questions asked, quizzes and saved phrases; queue a link or a phrase

settings.label: Speech server
settings.help: An address that speaks the OpenAI API: https://api.openai.com, or a server in your network such as http://voice.local (over http:// the API key travels unencrypted: use https:// where the server has it)

settings.label: API key
settings.help: The speech server's API key (for OpenAI: sk-…). Leave empty for a server in your network that needs none.

settings.label: Voice model
settings.help: The model that speaks, e.g. gpt-4o-mini-tts or tts-1; Settings → Retell lists what your server has

settings.label: Voice
settings.help: alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, nova, onyx, sage, shimmer, verse, marin, cedar, or a voice your server has

settings.label: Speaking style
settings.help: How the voice should speak, e.g. calm, warm, lively (English works best; tts-1 and tts-1-hd ignore it)

settings.label: Speech recognition model
settings.help: The model that writes down what you say, e.g. gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, gpt-4o-transcribe or whisper-1

settings.label: Fact check
settings.help: fix: check the retelling against the article and correct what is wrong; report: only report; off: skip. The report is under “Facts” in the article.

settings.label: Retelling language
settings.help: en, ru, uk … the language the retelling is written (and voiced) in; each article can have its own (Add → Language)

settings.label: Language of explanations
settings.help: The language feedback on your English, phrase cards and reading lists are explained in, e.g. English, Russian, Ukrainian, German (English examples stay English)

settings.label: Notify when ready
settings.help: Echo shows a notification when an article is ready to listen to (or needs attention)

settings.label: Remind to review phrases
settings.help: Once a day (after 9:00) Echo reminds you when phrases from My phrases are due for review

settings.label: PDF pages per part
settings.help: A PDF longer than this is split into parts of this many pages: each part is an article of its own, all in one topic

settings.label: Keep articles
settings.help: How many articles to keep; older ones are deleted (those you pinned stay). 0 keeps all.

settings.label: Storage limit, MB
settings.help: When the articles take more, the oldest unpinned ones are deleted. 0 means no limit.
